premises.text: Cattle weight is critical for health, genetics, sale timing, and farm value, but traditional weighing is laborious, stressful, causes weight loss, and is rarely done
premises.evidence_span: obtaining weight information is labor-intensive, time-consuming, and expensive, so it's rarely obtained

premises.text: Portable 3D-camera software estimates cattle weight automatically as animals pass, stress-free and about ten times faster than traditional weighing
premises.evidence_span: uses a portable 3D camera to estimate the weight of the cattle, allowing farmers to monitor weight variation frequently at a stress-free manner for the cow, at a rate that is 10 times faster than the traditional process

premises.text: Dashboard recommendations help farmers optimize weight gain and profitability (sale timing, feed, sickness, genetics)
premises.evidence_span: farmers can see our dashboard with recommendations on how to optimize weight gain and profitability

premises.text: Portable camera plus per-animal monthly fee is cheaper than passage scales and works for farms of all sizes without requiring animals to stand still
premises.evidence_span: Olho do Dono is portable. The 3D camera costs around R$ 3,000 and we charge R$ 1 per animal month

premises.text: Platform recommends products that optimize weight gain and earns commission on those products
premises.evidence_span: Our platform also gives recommendations on products that can optimize weight gain and we make a commission fee on that

value.text: Increase beef cattle productivity and profitability while maintaining cow well-being
value.evidence_span: increase the beef cattle productivity and profitability while maintaining the well-being of the cow

causal_links.evidence_span: We help farmers to grow their bottom lines
